description:
Update a time block (title, duration, anchor, note, done, people and pages; for a task bucket, its filter: filter_tag_id, filter_due). Only send fields you want to change. The block keeps its position in the timeline order.

Marking a block done records when it actually happened (it ends now and starts its planned duration earlier, never before the previous done block ended); the times can be corrected in the app. In the app's day view, what is done moves to the top, in the order it was done, and what is left follows; a finished fixed-time block no longer pushes anything. The block "in progress" is simply the first one not marked done, whatever the time.

contact_ids, company_ids and tag_ids replace the block's people, companies and pages; a new title with #page# or @Name@ adds what it names.

anchor_time.description: Fixed wall-clock hour HH:MM. Pass null to unpin (the block flows with the rest again).

company_ids.description: Companies linked to the block (company ids). Replaces the list.

contact_ids.description: People linked to the block (contact ids). Replaces the list. A title with @Name@ also links that person.

done.description: Mark the block done (true) or not done (false)

filter_due.description: Task buckets only: which tasks to show, by due date — today, overdue (today only), week (from this day to Sunday), asap, someday, all. null = the day's tasks (today + overdue + ASAP on today), the default. Every bucket shows ALL the open tasks matching its filter, even if another bucket shows them too; the app displays what fits in the block's duration (15 min per task without a duration) and the rest under « show more ».

filter_tag_id.description: Task buckets only: show only the tasks linked to this page (tag id, from list_tags). null = all pages.

note.description: Text of the block's first linked note (created and linked if the block has none). An empty value or null changes nothing: to detach a note, use unlink_day_block_note.

tag_ids.description: Pages linked to the block (tag ids, from list_tags). Replaces the list. A title with #page# or [[page]] also links that page (created if needed).

name: update_day_block
